name: BiFi Lending idle USDT market (0x808c3ba9...) drain
orig_verdict: Recorded classification; public transaction ordering and funds retained.
race_type_reason: The attacker deployed a purpose-built contract in block 26210255 and never called it. The next block contains c0ffeebabe.eth at position 1, with the market funds removed and 0.9868 ETH paid to the builder. Classification retains the recorded deploy-window result; only transaction, block, position and funds are published.
one_liner: One block after an attacker deployed a purpose-built BiFi USDT-market drain contract, and before it was ever called, c0ffeebabe.eth's tx emptied the market (netting 165,574.51 USDT, 68.06 WETH) and paid 0.9868 ETH to the builder.

attack_txs.role: CREATE purpose-built contract 0x8c0d729d (owner-only execute); no call to it ever landed or reverted

mempool_note: mempool-dumpster covers 2026-10-17 (csv.zip; 381/518 txs of block 26210255 and 111/276 of 26210256 present) but neither the attacker deploy tx nor the bot tx is in it (race files mempool.txs[hash].seen=false): private flow or missed. No ms deploy-to-call window can be computed.

trigger.note: No first-seen for the attacker deploy tx (block 26210255 pos 333) in mempool-dumpster; the deploy block's own timing from relays (winning block for 26210255 first submitted at +1221 ms, 05:43:00.221 UTC) is public-chain timing only, not a mempool trigger. No attacker call tx exists.

attacker_block_note: The attacker never called its contract (txlist of 0x8c0d729d = creation only; trace scan of blocks 26210240-26210300 finds no call into it; EOA's next tx is unrelated, block 26210307). Reference = deploy block 26210255.

auction.auction_note: Winning block = Titan, 0.990070 ETH, first submitted +1011 ms in slot 15449314 (2026-10-17T05:43:12.011Z UTC). A higher bid (1.3646 ETH, builder.ultrasound.money, +920 ms) was not delivered. Deploy block 26210255 was first submitted (winning hash) at +1221 ms of its slot, 2026-10-17T05:43:00.221Z UTC; the winning block for 26210256 first appeared 11.79 s after that and the first bid built on block 26210255 as parent came 2.87 s after it (race_26210256.json bids).

loot.gross_loot_method: WETH Transfer log into the bot's contract in the bot tx receipt: the bot swapped 165574.514633 USDT for 68.057203112 WETH (ETH-equivalent 1:1).

captured_native.desc: USDT swapped to 68.057203 WETH; market USDT balance 170,038.086459 -> 4,462.936729 over block 26210256

loot.captured_usd_source: USDT face value (1 USDT = $1) of the USDT Transfer to the swap pool in receipts_26210256.json
loot.loot_note: Bot tx only. bot_net = WETH proceeds - coinbase payment - total gas cost (0.000845755 ETH; the tx pays no priority fee), before any later return; ETH-equivalent, assumes the swap proceeds are the tx's only inflow (Morpho flash loan of 40,499,999.999997 USDT repaid in the tx). No builder->bot transfer in the block (builder fee recipient's only transfers go to 0xfeeeee44, the proposer-payment relay contract).

fate.returned_desc: No return found: c0ffeebabe's EOA txs from 26210256 to 26260000 (Etherscan, 1000 listed) show no transfer to the market, protocol or attacker contract; no protocol or whitehat statement found. Unknown != none.
fate.return_status_rule: returned = everything went back to the victim side except a bounty the victim agreed to or offered; partial = some came back, otherwise; none = known zero within the documented search window; unknown = unresolved

discrepancies: market USDT net out 165575.149730 (Transfer logs; balance 170,038.086459 -> 4,462.936729) vs 165574.514633 USDT swapped to WETH by the bot contract: 0.635097 USDT difference stays unaccounted at tx level (not investigated: contract internals).
